note: Every limitation a report can print lives here, so the wording is reviewed once rather than drifting across branches in coordinator.js. Changing an entry changes the report hash only when that limitation applies.
usefulness: This grade measures correctness against the assignment's tests, structure, memory discipline, readability and originality. It does not measure whether the program is a good solution to the problem, whether the student can explain it, or whether the design would survive a change in requirements.

entries.no_reference_solution: No reference solution is set, so edge cases are checked for well-formed output only.
entries.no_tests: No test cases are attached to this assignment, so correctness and edge cases are unmeasured.
entries.llm_unavailable: The optional language-model review is not configured or not enabled for this rule set.
entries.compile_error: The program did not compile; every metric except syntax is reported as unavailable.
entries.no_compiler_flags: The sandbox compiles with a fixed command line and cannot be given compiler flags, so the rule set's -Wall/-Wextra diagnostics were not available. Errors are still detected.
entries.provider_limits: The sandbox fixes its own memory and process ceilings, so the rule set's memory and process limits were not enforced.
entries.no_peers: No other submissions existed when originality was measured, so that score is provisional.
entries.no_oracle: No reference solution was available for the generated edge cases, so their score is capped.
entries.analyzer_failed: At least one check could not complete and is reported as unavailable rather than as a zero.
entries.sandbox_limits: Runs are capped by the sandbox at 30 seconds wall time and 512 MB of memory.
